question: Who was the founder of the social reform movement for Sikhism - the Nirankari movement?
solution:
The correct answer is **" Baba Dyal Das ".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Baba Dyal Das was the founder of the social reform movement for sikhism- the** Nirankari movement.**
 
• The motive of this movement was **purification and return**.
 
• He called for the** return of Sikhism** to its origin and emphasized the** worship of one god**.
 
• This approach means** rejecting idolatry and prohibiting**** eating meat, drinking liquor, cheating**, etc.
